prayers.divineMercyOffering: Eternal Father, I offer You the Body and Blood, Soul and Divinity of Your dearly beloved Son, Our Lord Jesus Christ, in atonement for our sins and those of the whole world.
prayers.divineMercyPetition: For the sake of His sorrowful Passion, have mercy on us and on the whole world.
prayers.divineMercyClosingAcclamation: Holy God, Holy Mighty One, Holy Immortal One, have mercy on us and on the whole world.
